smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (a Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (iA Ref)(b Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (iA Ref)(c Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D (mk-D (iB Ref)(iC Ref)(d Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Master (mk-Master (d Ref)(RESULT Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  (lift-D (sel-D D))
  (lift-Master (sel-Master Master))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D ((this Ref)) D
  (sel-D (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Master ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Master (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Master ((this Ref)) Master
  (sel-Master (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-A this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-C this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-D this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Master ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Master this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.a: ---

(define-fun A.a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-A this))
)

(define-fun A!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.iA: ---

(define-fun B.iA ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iA (deref-B this))
)

(define-fun B!iA ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iA (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.b: ---

(define-fun B.b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-B this))
)

(define-fun B!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-B this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class C:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for C.iA: ---

(define-fun C.iA ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iA (deref-C this))
)

(define-fun C!iA ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iA (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.c: ---

(define-fun C.c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-C this))
)

(define-fun C!c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-C this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class D:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for D.iB: ---

(define-fun D.iB ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iB (deref-D this))
)

(define-fun D!iB ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iB (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.iC: ---

(define-fun D.iC ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iC (deref-D this))
)

(define-fun D!iC ((this Ref)) Ref
  (iC (deref-D this))
)

; --- getters for D.d: ---

(define-fun D.d ((this Ref)) Int
  (d (deref-D this))
)

(define-fun D!d ((this Ref)) Int
  (d (deref-D this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Master:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Master.d: ---

(define-fun Master.d ((this Ref)) Ref
  (d (deref-Master this))
)

(define-fun Master!d ((this Ref)) Ref
  (d (deref-Master this))
)

; --- getters for Master.RESULT: ---

(define-fun Master!RESULT ((this Ref)) Int
  (RESULT (deref-Master this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class A:
; ------------------------

(define-fun A.f ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (+ (A.a this) k)
)

(define-fun A!f ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (+ (A!a this) k)
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class B:
; ------------------------

(define-fun B.g ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (A.f (B.iA this) (+ (+ (A.a (B.iA this)) (B.b this)) k))
)

(define-fun B!g ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (A.f (B!iA this) (+ (+ (A.a (B!iA this)) (B!b this)) k))
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class C:
; ------------------------

(define-fun C.h ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (A.f (C.iA this) (+ (+ (A.a (C.iA this)) (C.c this)) k))
)

(define-fun C!h ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (A.f (C!iA this) (+ (+ (A.a (C!iA this)) (C!c this)) k))
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class D:
; ------------------------

(define-fun D.i ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (+ (+ (+ (+ (A.a (B.iA (D.iB this))) (B.b (D.iB this))) (C.c (D.iC this))) (D.d this)) k)
)

(define-fun D!i ((this Ref)(k Int)) Int
  (+ (+ (+ (+ (A.a (B.iA (D!iB this))) (B.b (D!iB this))) (C.c (D!iC this))) (D!d this)) k)
)

; -----------------------------
;   Methods for class Master:
; -----------------------------

(define-fun Master.main ((this Ref)) Int
  (+ (+ (A.f (B.iA (D.iB (Master.d this))) 1) (B.g (D.iB (Master.d this)) 2)) (D.i (Master.d this) 3))
)

(define-fun Master!main ((this Ref)) Int
  (+ (+ (A.f (B.iA (D.iB (Master!d this))) 1) (B.g (D.iB (Master!d this)) 2)) (D.i (Master!d this) 3))
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-A A)
(declare-const const-3-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 2) :named _xkassert0))
(assert (! (A.inv1 3) :named _xkassert1))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!b this) 2)
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 4) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (B!iA this))
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 4) :named _xkassert3))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-C C)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun C.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!c this) 3)
)

(assert (! (C.inv1 5) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (C!iA this))
)

(assert (! (C.inv2 5) :named _xkassert5))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class D:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-6-D D)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun D.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (D!d this) 4)
)

(assert (! (D.inv1 6) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun D.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-B (D!iB this))
)

(assert (! (D.inv2 6) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun D.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-C (D!iC this))
)

(assert (! (D.inv3 6) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun D.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B.iA (D!iB this)) (C.iA (D!iC this)))
)

(assert (! (D.inv4 6) :named _xkassert9))



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Master:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Master Master)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Master.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Master!RESULT this) (+ (Master!main this) (Master!main this)))
)

(assert (! (Master.inv1 1) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Master.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-D (Master!d this))
)

(assert (! (Master.inv2 1) :named _xkassert11))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        2 (lift-A const-2-A))
        3 (lift-A const-3-A))
        4 (lift-B const-4-B))
        5 (lift-C const-5-C))
        6 (lift-D const-6-D))
        1 (lift-Master const-1-Master))
  )
)
